children: shares surged more than 10% to about $313 Wednesday as investors embraced new partnerships linking the cybersecurity company with OpenAI and SpaceX
The rally reflects expectations that Cloudflare's

global network could become valuable as AI agents write code, run applications and create new security threats. Its second-quarter revenue rose 36% year over year to $696.1 million, giving investors evidence that demand was already accelerating before the latest announcements.
operates a network spanning more than 300 data centers, routing traffic while protecting websites, applications and corporate systems.
Cloudflare Connects AI Growth With Cybersecurity

introduced Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation, combining live traffic intelligence from its network with OpenAI's Daybreak cybersecurity models. The service analyzes code, identifies dangerous vulnerabilities and can draft fixes automatically.

says organizations can identify and block high-risk attacks at the network edge before criminals exploit them. The pitch is timely because rapidly generated AI code can increase software output while potentially multiplying security flaws.
A separate partnership lets customers of SpaceXAI, the AI unit of SpaceX

, run Cursor Cloud Agents inside Cloudflare Sandboxes. Those isolated environments allow companies to deploy coding agents under customer-controlled rules, addressing concerns about security, access and data handling.

launch of Adaptive Intelligence, a detection engine designed to react quickly when AI-powered bots breach defenses. Together, the products position the company as infrastructure for both building AI agents and protecting systems from them.
Wall Street maintains a Strong Buy consensus on Cloudflare
, based on 22 Buy ratings, five Holds and one Sell. The average $348 target implies about 11% upside from Wednesday's price.

After a 10% surge, expectations are higher. Investors now need evidence that partnerships translate into durable revenue, stronger customer spending and improving operating leverage rather than publicity alone.

title: OpenAI and SpaceX Deals Send Cloudflare Stock Flying
